title: fetch_account_counts silently swallows DB errors
description: api.rs:171-186. fetch_account_counts() calls three fieldwork_db functions and uses .unwrap_or(0) on each, silently discarding any database errors. This means if the DB connection fails or the query errors, the API returns 0 counts instead of propagating the error. For a single-user server where these numbers are displayed prominently, returning wrong data without any log message is worse than returning an error. At minimum, log a warning on Err.
